subject: Expedited evidence sprint for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / SIG — ingestion plan
messages:
From: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@procurement.astra-fin.com>
To: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@astra-fin.com>, Astra-Security <security@astra-fin.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP follow-up — required SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence and timeline

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the quick RFP packet. Procurement and security at Astra have reviewed the materials and we need to lock an expedited evidence delivery schedule to meet our vendor approval window. Key asks: 

- Completed SIG questionnaire with control mapping to Redwood artifacts (source + locator)
- SOC 2 Type II report and control evidence (logs, policies, access lists) for 2026 timeframe
- ISO 27001 scope statement and statement of applicability (SoA) + evidence for the controls called out
- A manifest describing where each proof lives and how to retrieve (preferably stable URLs or presigned S3 links)

Can Redwood commit to an initial artifact bundle by Tuesday, June 1, and a final handoff by Friday, June 4? If that timeline is unrealistic, please propose the earliest feasible delivery cadence. Also confirm preferred secure transfer method (S3 pre-signed, Azure AD share, or encrypted Drive).

Regards,
Derek Shaw
Senior Sourcing Manager, Astra Financial
[Attachment: astra_rfp_summary.pdf (PDF)]

From: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@procurement.astra-fin.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@astra-fin.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — required SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence and timeline

Thanks Derek — we can support an accelerated sprint. Proposed plan: 

1) Initial bundle (control mapping + artifact manifest): deliver by Tue, Jun 1, 18:00 PT. This will include a completed SIG matrix with pointers and a CSV manifest of attached proofs.
2) Evidence ingestion run: Jun 2–3 — marissa and priyom will upload artifacts to an encrypted S3 bucket and validate access.
3) Final delivery (hand-off + verification): Fri, Jun 4, 12:00 PT.

I've attached a draft control matrix that maps common SIG sections to Redwood control IDs — marissa, please review ownership; priyom, can you confirm we can produce the requested presigned links by Jun 1? Karthik, can you confirm there are no blockers from the Dedicated/Private control perspectives?

Transfer method: we prefer an encrypted, time-limited S3 bucket (pre-signed links) or Secure Share. If Astra requires a different channel, let me know.

Attachments: astra_control_matrix_v1.xlsx (mapping, draft), ingestion_runbook.pdf (upload playbook).

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0138
[Attachment: astra_control_matrix_v1.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: lena@astra-fin.com, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@procurement.astra-fin.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 14:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — required SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence and timeline

Looping in control owners and giving a quick pass at the matrix. Highlights and ownership suggestions: 

- Logical Access (SIG control LA-01..LA-10): owned by Security Ops — I'll own mapping for LA-01..LA-04; Jonas will take LA-05..LA-07.
- Change Management (CM-*): Prod infra + release engineering — Karthik will consolidate artifacts (change logs, approvals).
- Data Retention / Encryption: Marissa + Priyom will provide policy excerpts and KMS key logs where applicable.

I attached the ingestion runbook which outlines naming conventions and the proofs_manifest.csv schema we'll use. We'll pre-stage files in the intake path and produce presigned-get links for each artifact. Expect a short validation call Jun 1 AM (30 min) to confirm access.

- Attachment: ingestion_runbook.pdf
- Planned artifact list: proofs_manifest.csv (will be generated Jun 1)

Marissa Cole
Manager, Trust & Security Programs | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ingestion_runbook.pdf (PDF)]

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena@astra-fin.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:16:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: RFP follow-up — required SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence and timeline

Confirming schedule and security gating: 

- We will spin an encrypted S3 intake bucket (region: us-west-2) and produce presigned GET links scoped to each artifact. ETA for links: Jun 1, 16:00 PT.
- For any redacted logs (e.g., IAM logs), we'll provide a checksum and a short redaction note in proofs_manifest.csv.
- Security approval: Jonas, can you greenlight the bucket policy and TTL (48 hours per link)?

Action items: 
- Marissa: finalize control mapping ownership by EOD May 31.
- Karthik: collect change management artifacts and location paths.
- Jonas: review bucket policy.

Priyom Das
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proofs_manifest.csv (CSV stub)]

From: avery_johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@procurement.astra-fin.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena@astra-fin.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — required SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence and timeline

Derek / Lena — quick status and access details.

1) Initial bundle delivered: control matrix (astra_control_matrix_v1.xlsx) + proofs_manifest.csv + ingestion_runbook.pdf are uploaded to our secure intake.
2) Access method: encrypted S3 intake with time-limited presigned URLs. Sample link (expires in 48h): https://redwood.app/secure-share/ASTRA-2027-07/sample-presigned-link
3) Full manifest and links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AstraSharedBucket (Astra has read-only view)

Next steps: please validate one sample artifact and confirm you can download before Jun 3 AM. We'll continue ingestion Jun 2–3 and plan for final handoff Jun 4 12:00 PT. If you prefer a live joint validation call, we can set 30 minutes — propose Jun 2 10:00 PT.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround on your side.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0138
[Attachment: delivery_log.txt (TXT stub)]
